contract: Three responsive numbered cards separate physical flight and the released 40 Hz channels, training-only checks and frozen AR/ARX choices, and judgment-only validation with independent maneuver resets. Wind and manual synchronization delimit inference; validation cannot flow back into modeling choices.

iteration_notes: Iteration 1: all layouts were legible and overflow-free, but the exact channel-name labels and fit action were only implied, and reset was split from each validation filename.

Iteration 2: channel names/units, fit action, and per-file reset labels were explicit; no clipping, horizontal overflow, unresolved KaTeX, color-role drift, arrow/card collision, false validation feedback, theme defect, score, or measured-looking trace remained.

checks.scoped_typecheck_command: npx tsc --noEmit --jsx react-jsx --esModuleInterop --moduleResolution bundler --module esnext --target es2020 --skipLibCheck components/figures/digital-signal-processing/X8IdentificationPipeline.tsx
